tool_args.description: Extract all bib entry keys from relwork_new_entries.bib

tool_args.command:
python3 << 'PYEOF'
import re, glob, os
from collections import defaultdict

# Target .tex files
tex_files = [
    "section3_method_draft.tex",
    "section4_composition_draft.tex",
    "section5_scierc_draft.tex",
    "section5_docred_draft.tex",
    "section6_related_work.tex",
    "section6_relwork_additions.tex",
    "discussion_paragraphs.tex",
]

# Also check other .tex files for completeness
all_tex = glob.glob("*.tex")

# 1. Extract cite keys from .tex files (skip commented lines)
cite_pattern = re.compile(r'\\(?:cite[tp]?|citet|citep)\{([^}]+)\}')
cite_keys = set()
cite_by_file = defaultdict(set)

for f in tex_files:
    if not os.path.exists(f):
        print(f"WARNING: {f} not found")
        continue
    with open(f) as fh:
        for line in fh:
            stripped = line.lstrip()
            if stripped.startswith('%'):
                continue
            for m in cite_pattern.finditer(line):
                keys = [k.strip() for k in m.group(1).split(',')]
                for k in keys:
                    cite_keys.add(k)
                    cite_by_file[f].add(k)

# Also check remaining .tex files
other_tex_cites = set()
other_tex_files_with_cites = defaultdict(set)
for f in all_tex:
    if f in tex_files:
        continue
    if not os.path.exists(f):
        continue
    with open(f) as fh:
        for line in fh:
            stripped = line.lstrip()
            if stripped.startswith('%'):
                continue
            for m in cite_pattern.finditer(line):
                keys = [k.strip() for k in m.group(1).split(',')]
                for k in keys:
                    if k not in cite_keys:
                        other_tex_cites.add(k)
                        other_tex_files_with_cites[f].add(k)

# 2. Extract bib keys from .bib files
bib_pattern = re.compile(r'^@\w+\{(\S+?),', re.MULTILINE)
bib_keys = set()
bib_by_file = defaultdict(set)
dup_keys = defaultdict(list)

for f in glob.glob("*.bib"):
    with open(f) as fh:
        content = fh.read()
    for m in bib_pattern.finditer(content):
        key = m.group(1)
        if key in bib_keys:
            dup_keys[key].append(f)
        bib_keys.add(key)
        bib_by_file[f].add(key)

# 3. Cross-reference
missing = cite_keys - bib_keys
found = cite_keys & bib_keys

print("=" * 60)
print("CITE KEY 交叉检查报告")
print("=" * 60)

print(f"\n📊 统计:")
print(f"  .tex 文件中引用了 {len(cite_keys)} 个 unique cite keys (指定文件)")
print(f"  .bib 文件中定义了 {len(bib_keys)} 个条目")
print(f"  已匹配: {len(found)} 个")
print(f"  缺失: {len(missing)} 个")

if missing:
    print(f"\n❌ 缺失的 cite keys ({len(missing)}):")
    # Show which file references them
    for k in sorted(missing):
        files = [f for f, keys in cite_by_file.items() if k in keys]
        print(f"  - {k}  ← 引用自: {', '.join(files)}")

if dup_keys:
    print(f"\n⚠️  重复的 bib keys:")
    for k, files in sorted(dup_keys.items()):
        print(f"  - {k} 出现在多个文件: {files}")
else:
    print(f"\n✅ 无重复 bib keys")

if other_tex_cites:
    print(f"\n📎 其他 .tex 文件中的额外 cite keys (不在指定文件列表中):")
    for f, keys in sorted(other_tex_files_with_cites.items()):
        missing_other = keys - bib_keys
        if missing_other:
            print(f"  {f}: 缺失 {sorted(missing_other)}")

print(f"\n✅ 已匹配的 cite keys ({len(found)}):")
for k in sorted(found):
    print(f"  - {k}")

# Per-file breakdown
print(f"\n📁 各 .tex 文件引用详情:")
for f in tex_files:
    if f in cite_by_file:
        keys = cite_by_file[f]
        m = keys - bib_keys
        print(f"  {f}: {len(keys)} keys, {len(m)} missing")
        if m:
            print(f"    缺失: {sorted(m)}")

PYEOF
